text:
Maya: Quick note — AtlasOne just asked to do a joint marketplace + SI co-sell kickstart for APAC pilots. Need to lock lead routing before we announce.
Raj: ok — what’s the intake flow we want? single claim window or split by region?
Lena: propose: 48h claim window for any inbound leads, then routed to SI queue if unclaimed. APAC gets priority to AtlasOne for accounts in Japan/Australia/NZ.
Dina: +1. Also require a marketplace listing checklist done before we push joint email: pricing tile, contract link, and a short one-pager.
Maya: can we codify claims? e.g. agent types use `/claim ACCOUNT-123` in #partnerships-intake, then we log to SFDC with tag `atlasone_co-sell`.
Raj: that works. Sales team needs to be reminded to add account stage and attach the demo kit. I’ll ping ops to add a validation step in SFDC.
Lena: rule-of-engagements draft: 1) SI has 72h to respond to a claim follow-up call. 2) Redwood retains routing ability for enterprise accounts > $500k ARR. 3) For joint announcements, both sides sign off on copy within 5 business days.
Sam: who owns carveouts when accounts overlap with existing partners in EMEA?
Maya: overlap -> escalate to partnerships@redwood with a short rationale. Partnerships triage will arbitrate within 48h and post decision in channel.
Raj: add a small mapping snippet for mapping logic (for ops):
```
// simplified mapping
if (region == 'EMEA' && account_tier <= 'mid') route_to('regional_si_queue')
if (region == 'APAC' && partner == 'AtlasOne') route_to('atlasone_queue')
if (enterprise && ARR > 500000) route_to('redwood_direct_sales')
```
Dina: deploy-bot: can you create the AtlasOne co-sell queue in PagerDuty/ops? we need it for routing.
deploy-bot: created queue `atlasone_co_sell_queue` and webhook for #partnerships-intake — docs: https://redwood.internal/ops/queues/atlasone (auto)
Maya: ok next steps — Raj to confirm SFDC tag + validation, Dina to own checklist, Lena to finalize rules doc and share for sign-off. I’ll set a joint announcement milestone in the shared calendar and loop in comms.
Raj: will do, I’ll update ops by EOD and post the claim template in #partnerships-intake.
Lena: I’ll drop the rules doc in Drive and link here when ready.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup: any objections to rolling this out as a pilot for the next 3 weeks?
Sam: no objections from sales side.
Dina: good to pilot. If we hit >10 joint leads, we revisit SLA/claim timings.
Maya: perfect — closing the thread, will post the kickoff checklist when live.
